mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.title AS title, c.teacher_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(u.name, t.name, CONCAT('教师#', c.teacher_id)) AS teacherName, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.student_id) AS studentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT fcs.score_id) AS scoreCount, c.gmt_created AS gmtCreated FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.teacher_id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.teacher_id AND u.role = 'teacher' AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course_student cs ON cs.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN fact_course_score fcs ON fcs.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.title, c.teacher_id, teacherName, c.gmt_created ORDER BY c.gmt_created DESC, c.course_id DESC

SELECT t.teacher_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(u.name, t.name, CONCAT('教师#', t.teacher_id)) AS teacherName FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = t.teacher_id AND u.role = 'teacher' AND u.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.teacher_id
SELECT DISTINCT department_name FROM `user` WHERE role = 'student' AND is_deleted = 0 AND department_name IS NOT NULL AND department_name != '' ORDER BY department_name
SELECT term_id AS termId, term_name AS termName, status FROM dim_term ORDER BY term_id DESC

SELECT cs.id AS relationId, cs.course_id AS courseId, cs.student_id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, COALESCE(u.name, s.name) AS studentName, COALESCE(u.department_name, s.college) AS college, fcs.score_id AS scoreId, fcs.term_id AS termId, dt.term_name AS termName, fcs.usual_score AS usualScore, fcs.final_score AS finalScore, fcs.gpa_point AS gpaPoint, fcs.is_passed AS passed, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM learning_record lr WHERE lr.user_id = cs.student_id AND lr.course_id = cs.course_id ) AS linkedLearningRecord FROM course_student cs JOIN student s ON s.student_id = cs.student_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = cs.student_id AND u.role = 'student' AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inner_fcs.* FROM fact_course_score inner_fcs JOIN ( SELECT student_id, course_id, MAX(term_id) AS max_term_id FROM fact_course_score GROUP BY student_id, course_id ) latest ON latest.student_id = inner_fcs.student_id AND latest.course_id = inner_fcs.course_id AND latest.max_term_id = inner_fcs.term_id ) fcs ON fcs.student_id = cs.student_id AND fcs.course_id = cs.course_id LEFT JOIN dim_term dt ON dt.term_id = fcs.term_id WHERE cs.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cs.gmt_created DESC, cs.id DESC
